canDoYue: 你識帶發票去預算會議，問五千港紙以內可唔可以批核。
canDoEn: Bring an invoice to a budget meeting and ask for approval under five thousand dollars.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could you please bring the March invoice along to our budget meeting on Monday at ten o'clock?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以帶三月發票，去星期一十點嘅預算會議？
dialogue.say: Could you please bring the March invoice along to our budget meeting on Monday at ten o'clock?

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: I will bring that March invoice, and I have checked every single line against our written budget.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會帶三月發票，我對過書面預算每一行。
dialogue.say: I will bring that March invoice, and I have checked every single line against our written budget.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Will you approve the total on Monday if it stays under five thousand Hong Kong dollars only?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果總數唔超過五千港紙，你星期一會唔會批核？
dialogue.say: Will you approve the total on Monday if it stays under five thousand Hong Kong dollars only?

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: I will approve that invoice on Monday, because five thousand dollars still sits inside the March budget.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會喺星期一批核嗰張發票，因為五千蚊仲喺三月預算入面。
dialogue.say: I will approve that invoice on Monday, because five thousand dollars still sits inside the March budget.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could the meeting notes name the owner on Monday, without reading every line aloud to the room?
dialogue.glossYue: 星期一嘅會議紀錄可唔可以寫負責人，唔使喺房入面讀每一行？
dialogue.say: Could the meeting notes name the owner on Monday, without reading every line aloud to the room?

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: The meeting notes will name me as owner, and I will not read every line aloud there.
dialogue.glossYue: 會議紀錄會寫我做負責人，我唔會喺度讀每一行。
dialogue.say: The meeting notes will name me as owner, and I will not read every line aloud there.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Please approve it before the meeting starts, and leave the signed copy on my wooden desk later.
dialogue.glossYue: 開會之前請批核，遲啲將簽好嘅副本放喺我張木檯。
dialogue.say: Please approve it before the meeting starts, and leave the signed copy on my wooden desk later.

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: I will approve it before we start, and the signed copy can stay on your wooden desk.
dialogue.glossYue: 開會之前我會批核，簽好嘅副本可以留喺你張木檯。
dialogue.say: I will approve it before we start, and the signed copy can stay on your wooden desk.
